replacements.name: named-trig-components
named-trig-components
replacements.text:
float effect_cosine = (float)cos(effect_heading);
        effect_offset.x =
            effect_cosine
                    * player_state_table[render_overlay_player_index]
                          .muzzle_flash_alpha
                    * 12.0f
                - effect_cosine * 21.0f;
        float effect_sine = (float)sin(effect_heading);
        effect_offset.y =
            effect_sine
                    * player_state_table[render_overlay_player_index]
                          .muzzle_flash_alpha
                    * 12.0f
                - effect_sine * 21.0f;
